text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B after large gains, then sold more after its gain had narrowed; I’ll judge whether to keep a holding by its current prospects, not by the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I bought more of Stock C and added Stock D before later selling D at a loss; I’ll check position size, diversification, and downside risk before adding to a stock.","I held through several declining periods, then sold Stock D and Stock E at losses; I’ll set clear review and exit criteria in advance rather than let discomfort with losses dictate when I sell."]}
